Vendored browser dependencies (MIT licensed):

- Bootstrap 5.3.8 — https://github.com/twbs/bootstrap/blob/v5.3.8/LICENSE
- HTMX 2.0.8 — https://github.com/bigskysoftware/htmx/blob/v2.0.8/LICENSE
- Chart.js 4.5.1 — https://github.com/chartjs/Chart.js/blob/v4.5.1/LICENSE.md

Source URLs and SHA-256 hashes are recorded in manifest.json. These files are served locally;
running the app does not require access to a CDN.
